name: Tithing And Offerings
overview: Scripture teaches that tithing and offerings are sacred acts of worship, acknowledging that all we have belongs to the Lord, as Leviticus 27:30 declares the tithe is holy to God. Malachi 3:10 emphasizes the importance of faithfully bringing tithes to support God's house, promising abundant blessings in return. Jesus, in Matthew 23:23 and Luke 11:42, rebukes the Pharisees for focusing on minor tithing details while neglecting justice, mercy, and love, highlighting that both obedience in giving and a heart aligned with God's priorities are essential. Luke 6:38 further encourages generous giving, assuring that God measures our generosity with overflowing grace.
